components.name: Primary Button
components.description: WPF-inspired preview of the primary action; dimensions represent DIPs.

components.name: Watermark Field
components.description: Rectangular native watermark field with a mint focus border.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Text-only approximation of the left rail; items have at least 42-DIP surfaces and 6-DIP gaps. Selected text is white and its muted green background persists on hover. The actual shell also uses white image icons.

components.name: Subtabs
components.description: Selected subtab uses a green underline.

components.name: Wizard Steps
components.description: Current, completed and upcoming project steps.
components.html: <nav class="ds-steps"><button class="ds-step ds-done">Setup</button><button class="ds-step ds-current" aria-current="step">LiDAR</button><button class="ds-step">Capture</button></nav>

components.name: Data Grid
components.description: Simplified preview of the shared grid header, alternating rows and selection; project list rows are 36 DIP high with centered content.
components.css: .ds-grid{background:#fff;border:1px solid #D5DDE2;border-collapse:collapse;color:#334A5C;font:14px 'Roboto Condensed',Arial,sans-serif}.ds-grid th{background:#334A5C;color:#fff;padding:6px 8px;text-align:left;font-weight:700}.ds-grid td{height:36px;box-sizing:border-box;vertical-align:middle;border-bottom:1px solid #D5DDE2;padding:6px 8px}.ds-grid tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#F5F8FA}.ds-grid tbody tr.ds-selected{background:#E4FBF3}.ds-grid tbody tr:hover{background:#EAEFF2}

narrative.overview: The implemented shell combines dark blue-grey navigation with a cool, light workspace and compact controls for the existing verification workflow. The Helideck platform's transfer document, current source, and an older synthetic-data browser-test capture informed this revision; this record is not independent visual approval.
keyCharacteristics: Native WPF controls and data-dense grids.
Blue-grey structure, mint interaction accents, and explicit status colors.
Bundled condensed type and small, bordered surfaces.

rules.name: The Status Is Named Rule
rules.body: Where status is shown in a project list or chart legend, pair color with the existing text label rather than relying on color alone.

dos: Do use the shared SES resources for established control colors and states.
Do retain text labels alongside the existing status and chart color cues.
Do keep data-oriented layouts compact and preserve existing actions and content.
donts: Don't treat a chart series color as an error or success status.
Don't assume every screen uses the shared named text styles or a custom control template.
